findings.title: Unexpected result serialization failure escapes the post-execution refusal boundary
findings.impact: The executor returns a real DiscoveryResult, then its serializer raises RuntimeError. run_gateway propagates that exception with no fixed stderr or exit code. A normal module invocation can therefore print the unredacted traceback. No replacement JSON or fabricated effects were observed.
findings.repair: Keep the fixed emergency envelope restricted to the existing typed pre-execution catalog/provider case. Catch unexpected post-executor serialization/emission failures at the top-level boundary, emit only a fixed diagnostic and return 3 without a second JSON attempt or exception text. Preserve the no-partial-output replacement rule.
findings.minimum_controls: Unexpected serializer failure after executor return, alongside existing invalid-result, evaluated-catalog failure and partial-output controls. Assert fixed stderr, exit 3, no marker disclosure and no fabricated empty-effect result.

findings.title: The Git deadline is applied only after a potentially blocking stdout read

observed.qualification: The sentinel stops at read entry. This demonstrates deadline ordering only; no hung child or elapsed-time result is claimed.

findings.impact: A child that neither closes stdout nor supplies the requested bytes can hold the read indefinitely, so the later timed wait does not enforce a command deadline. Output byte capacity alone does not bound this blocking operation.
findings.repair: Apply a finite deadline across pipe consumption and process completion, retain the output_limit+1 ceiling before retention, and terminate/reap the child on timeout or overflow. Preserve the exact Git executable selection, shell=False, discarded stderr and stripped Git environment overrides. Do not use unbounded communicate/capture as a replacement.
findings.minimum_controls: A deterministic process/pipe double whose read remains pending until deadline cancellation, plus current success, overflow, nonzero and cleanup controls. Assert cancellation/reaping and no unbounded buffer; no flaky wall-clock threshold.
findings.qualification: The probe stops at read entry using a sentinel and records timeout/cleanup call order. No actual hung process, elapsed deadline or timing measurement is claimed.

findings.title: Doctor path traversal is not charged before candidate text measurement
findings.impact: One valid 32-component candidate path contains 4,095 characters. Under the existing trusted ParseLimits seam (8,192 bytes, 32 records, 2,048 work units), actual ReportBudget.text scans that value with all 2,048 units remaining; the operation returns exit 0 with 2,046 units remaining. The minimum demonstrated text traversal alone exceeds total configured work. No workspace byte read, write or revocation occurred.
findings.repair: Prospectively reserve actual candidate/selected-path text, set/sort and repeated comparison work in the same doctor operation budget before measurement, allocation or observation. Preserve exact capture/absence and existing selector/path safety semantics. Reuse accepted selection and snapshot implementations without modifying their behavior.
findings.minimum_controls: The same counted long-path/tight-work seam must reject before the text/path observation; a sufficient-capacity control must retain exact missing/captured inputs and truthful state. Keep aggregate byte-read and protected-locator controls unchanged.
findings.qualification: The finite policy is injected at the same doctor ParseLimits seam used by existing resource tests. This is a direct doctor composition finding, not a defect claim about ReportBudget's documented caller-owned work reservation.
